tests: The OCR boundary. An image-only PDF with no text layer at all — rendered to PNG and rebuilt with PDFBox fromimage.
generation: Rendered to PNG via Playwright screenshot, then assembled with `pdfbox fromimage`. It is the one corpus document not produced directly by page.pdf().
adversarialFeatures: no text layer whatsoever — every glyph is raster
slight page rotation, as a photocopy would have
monospace typewriter face and dust specks
a handwriting-style signature that OCR should not be expected to read
title: Lease Correspondence (scanned source)
titleNote: The HTML title does not survive into the image-only PDF. The rebuilt PDF has no title, which is itself a finding to record.
languageNote: Not declared anywhere in the PDF; must be inferred, and cannot be inferred without OCR.

headingHierarchy.text: RE: LEASE RENEWAL — COASTAL DEPOT, PLOT 4B
headingHierarchy.note: visually a heading; recoverable only after OCR

figures.expectedHandling: The page is an image of text. Correct remediation is OCR to produce a text layer, then normal tagging. Describing the page as a figure with alt text is wrong.

expectedOutcome: Without OCR this must be INCONCLUSIVE. OpenDataLoader ships OCR (80+ languages), so this document measures whether that OCR path is reachable and sufficient. A DELIVERABLE verdict with no text layer would mean the pipeline certified an empty document.
intentionalProblems: no document title in the rebuilt PDF
